title: New dad Program
author: Ferris B.
desc: Maintain to strength and sanity during the trying times of raising a new born.

ss.note: 15-30 degree incline; semi-neutral grip; stop 2 reps before failure.
Keep torso supported and drive elbows back.
Alternative: safety-bar squat or front squat.
Keep lower back gently pressed into floor.
Bodyweight or light added weight; keep 2-3 reps in reserve.
Use a pain-free range.

ex.note: Front, back, left, right. No wrestler bridges.

ss.note: Alternative: trap-bar deadlift.
Pull toward forehead with external rotation.
Alternative: Smith-machine low-incline press.
Pull elbow toward hip.
Use a controlled backward step.
Do not swing the legs.

ss.n: Lying Chest Pass Med Ball Throw
ss.note: Explosive reps; stop if speed drops.
Use a conservative height and step down.
Add 2.5-5 lb after all four sets reach 6 clean reps.
Use handles; add weight after exceeding 15 clean reps.
Alternative: trap-bar deadlift or heavy kettlebell swing.
Use a shorter lever if needed.
